1.o: The recluse Jintan is stumped when his deceased childhood friend Menma suddenly appears one day and asks him to make her wish come true.

2.o: Seeing Poppo at the hideout, Jintan reveals Menma appeared asking him to make her wish come true. Poppo believes Jintan and gives him advice.

3.o: Jintan decides to go to school again, thinking that might be Menma’s wish, and also to keep his promise to Anaru.

4.o: Yukiatsu tells Jintan and friends he has seen Menma in the woods. Jintan is certain he's lying but goes with the others to find out the truth.

5.o: Jintan solves the mystery of the wandering Menma, and confronts the person responsible.

6.o: Trying to figure out Menma's wish, Jinta decides to make his long-delayed return to school. However, his return is overshadowed by rumours about Anaru having been spotted at a love hotel.

7.o: Anaru has run away from home and is living in the hideout. Jintan tells her she cannot skip school or be away from home forever. Anaru makes a decision.

8.o: Jintan has a plan to fulfill Menma's wish, but Menma’s dad is opposed to the idea. Jintan tries to persuade her mom instead.

9.o: The gang go round to Jinta's house where they witness Menma's presence first hand, though it is shown that Menma is unable to write anywhere but the secret base. Yukiatsu becomes frustrated that only Jinta can see Menma, whilst Anaru is upset that she can't compare to her.

10.o: Jinta asks Menma if she would rather stay here so that they could be together, to which Menma responds that she plans to go on to heaven and be reincarnated.

11.t: The Flower Blooming on That Summer
11.o: The gang's cermony to help Menma pass on didn't go as planned, and they realize they need to put their own selfishness aside to figure out what Menma really wants.

1.o: قصة ملحمة حدثت أثناء الاحتلال الفرنسي لدمشق.
Shin Ji Hyun prepares for her wedding to Kang Min Ho, but an unfortunate accident causes her to end up brain-dead in a coma.

2.o: Ji Hyun relishes her new body when she possesses Song Yi Kyung. She applies for a job at Han Kang's restaurant.

3.o: Ji Hyun discovers Min Ho and In Jung's affair behind her back, and their schemes against her father's company.

4.o: Desperate to thwart Min Ho and In Jung, Ji Hyun races to find her seal. She learns of her best friend and fiance's long history together.

5.o: Depressed about her reality, the Scheduler takes Ji Hyun shopping to cheer her up. Meanwhile, Min Ho can't shake off a growing attraction towards Yi Kyung.

6.o: Han Kang continually butts heads with Yi Kyung, who continually reminds him of Ji Hyun, in an attempt to cover his feelings.

7.o: Ji Hyun becomes Min Ho's housemaid using Yi Kyung's body, but her activities lead to negative consequences for the real Yi Kyung.

8.o: Yi Kyung's presence at Min Ho's home unsettles In Jung. Meanwhile, Han Kang can't forget Yi Kyung despite firing her.

9.o: Ji Hyun's father's brain tumor worsens, prompting him to write up a new will leaving the company to Min Ho.

10.o: Her 49 days almost halfway over, Ji Hyun faces the very possible reality that no one around her truly loves her.

11.o: Ji Hyun goes on a search to thank the person who cried for her, while Kang searches for the truth about Ji Hyun/Yi Kyung.

12.o: Ji Hyun starts to lose control of Yi Kyung during the day, which leaves Yi Kyung confused. Yi Kyung takes a stroll on memory lane.

13.o: Worried that Kang is onto her secret, Ji Hyun is more determined to take care of the Min Ho situation before her 49 days.

14.o: Ji Hyun learns about the Scheduler's past and confronts him about it, which causes him to put things in perspective.

15.o: Yi Kyung recounts her backstory for Dr. Noh, but they are not alone. Kang takes Ji Hyun to visit her father in the hospital.

16.o: Yi Soo recounts his heartbreaking his past with Yi Kyung. Kang and Min Ho fight over Ji Hyun while Seo Woo confronts In Jung with the truth.

17.o: Both Kang and Ji Hyun race to stop Yi Kyung from running away. Min Ho tries to exorcise Ji Hyun's spirit.

18.o: Kang and Ji Hyun deliver the seal to her mother and attempt to tell her father about Min Ho. Yi Kyung also receives gifts from Ji Hyun.

19.o: Ji Hyun receives her third tear which allows her to wake up from her coma.

20.o: Ji Hyun is able to recall her adventure during the past 49 days and receives a visit from Yi Soo, but why?

1.o: In isolation his entire life, Nagate must adjust to life in a centuries-old space colony while training as a cadet pilot to fight an ancient threat.

2.o: Nagate is haunted by his first combat experience against the Gauna. Later, he meets the elite pilots of Sidonia.

3.o: Exploring Sidonia, Nagate makes an enemy of Kunato while protecting a friend. The Gauna attack, calling the pilots into action.

4.o: After a disaster aboard Sidonia, Nagate and his team are ordered to retrieve a valued weapon. He later defies orders to save a friend.

5.o: Nagate and Shizuka, adrift in space, slowly run out of supplies as they await rescue from a departing Sidonia, which is too far away to send help.

6.o: Nagate and his squad graduate as pilots and are quickly sent into combat when the enemy returns; Kunato explores Nagate's history.

7.o: The enemy is revealed to be even larger and deadlier than previously believed, resulting in three squads engaging in a deadly fight.

8.o: Nagate is blamed for a defeat and harbors guilt over a casualty; the early years of Sidonia are revealed.

9.o: The Gauna find a distressing way to demoralize and out-fight the attack force. Nagate returns to Sidonia with a prize that may help in the fight.

10.o: Pacifists endanger themselves by leaving the relative safety of Sidonia, while the enemy shows up larger and fiercer than before.

11.o: A large strike force encounters an enemy unit that takes them by surprise; Nagate does what he can to protect his friends.

12.o: Nagate fights one-on-one with the heart of his enemy while the strike force does not fare well in its attack on the Gauna.

1.o: Pilot Nagate Tanikaze is now renowned for his actions in the recent battle, but Nagate is more concerned with the disappearance of the ena Hoshijiro.

2.o: Nagate and his team fight a hard battle against Gauna 549, aided by the appearance of a new type of gauna calling itself Tsumugi Shiraui.

3.o: Having disposed of the opposition, Kobayashi sets Sidonia's course to the ninth planet in the nearby Lem System. All-out war now seems unavoidable.

4.o: A new threat appears in the form of Gauna 550, which has ejected countless lesser gauna cores on an intercept trajectory with Sidonia.

5.o: Despite being instrumental in their victory, Tsumugi is severely damaged defending Sidonia. Izana, also critically injured, makes a bold decision.

6.o: Evicted from his dorm and with nowhere to go, Nagate asks to stay with Izana for a night; Tsumugi has an emotional crisis triggered by a close call.

7.o: The Sidonia's new weapon test succeeds, but the crew realizes they can't shut it down; Yuhata sends the garde pilots to investigate the disturbance.

8.o: The pilots and Tsumugi repair damage to the Sidonia following the Gravitational Beam Emitter incident; Tsumugi is upset for causing a minor accident.

9.o: Izana finds out her 'date' with Nagate was a setup and storms home. Soon after, she is called to be part of a team that will scout out Planet Nine.

10.o: The reconnaissance team is attacked by the gauna; Izana and the squad leader manage to escape into the atmosphere of Planet Nine.

11.o: Izana and the recon squad leader are pursued by an enormous humanoid gauna. Meanwhile, Tsumugi faces off against the Crimson Hawk Moth.

12.o: Nagate rescues Tsumugi but is overpowered by the Crimson Hawk Moth. The situation looks grim as swarms of gauna bear down on the survivors.

1.o: A girl finds herself in a house full of bloodthirsty vampires. Unable to escape and with traditional anti-vampire weapons being useless, she becomes lost within the labyrinth of hallways.

2.o: After being told to behave or face certain doom, Yui is coerced by Ayato to skip class, and she submits to his every whim.

3.o: Ayato has claimed Yui as his own and is furious to discover the bite marks of another. He confronts the culprit and a game of darts will decide who Yui belongs to in the end.

4.o: Yui, still intent on escaping the horrors of the mansion, learns a shocking truth from one of her oppressors.

5.o: More information is revealed to Yui about the brothers' past, even as she endures her life's blood being drained by two of them.

6.o: Yui continues to struggle adjusting to life with the vampire brethren. Subaru grants her desire to flee, but something is keeping her there.

7.o: A mysterious woman gives Yui a chance to look into the past, when Ayato and his brothers were young boys.

8.o: Yui seeks out Shu to ask him about the sudden chest pains she is experiencing, but instead she learns more about her later father.

9.o: Amid Yui's growing concern for her safety, the boys uncle appears, and shows her the reason she has stayed alive this long.

10.o: Cordelia and Richter are reunited once again. Ayato demands to know what has happened to Yui.

11.o: A fight breaks out between the boys and Richter, and while Ayato proclaims Yui to be his, Richter brandishes a knife.

12.o: The struggle between Yui and Cordelia for control over the body comes to a head. The boys hatch a plan to get rid of Cordelia for good.

1.o: After the Sakamaki brothers along with Yui recently experienced a car accident, the cause of it was four new vampires that where non-pure bloods who want Yui for her blood

2.o: Yui Komori wakes up to realize she's in Mukami's mansion. She was taken by the brothers and is told she is to live there with them. The Mukami brothers need Yui for their "plan" and call her "Eve.

3.o: After getting her blood sucked by Ruki Mukami, Yui Komori wakes up in her own room the next day. She enters the living room where the 4 Mukami brothers are enjoying dinner together. They leave for school telling Yui to stay with Azusa.

4.o: Yuma takes Yui to a garden where he grows vegetables. Yui asks his purpose for growing them if vampires don't need to eat food like humans. he begins to talk about his and the Mukami brothers' past

5.o: Kou gives Yui roses as a gift. Yui is confused when Kou demands something in return and suddenly changes Kou feeds on her, Kou later returns asks Yui to help him Yui goes to his room and discovers multiple scars on Kou's

6.o: Ruki suddenly allows Yui Komori to attend school. she reunites with Kanato, Laito, and Reiji but they disappear without a conversation. Walking alone, Yui is grabbed by Subaru and is dragged to the rooftop. Kou appears there as well

7.o: Ruki starts feeling impatient when Kou and Azusa they confirm they don't have any signs of the awakening. Yui trips on the school stairs due to lack of blood, but is saved by Yuma. On their way to the nurse's office, they run into Shu

8.o: Ruki has been secluded in his room lately and his brothers have noticed his change in behavior. Ruki suddenly appears and takes Yuito the basement room. There, Ruki feeds on her blood and Yui blacks out.

9.o: Yui wakes up in her room in the Sakamaki mansion where Laito feeds on her but Reiji interferes and tells Yui to come to the living room. In the living room, Reiji asks about the Mukami brothers and Yui tells him all she knows

10.o: Yui resists while Shu takes her blood and this makes him crave it even more. Kou, Yuma, and Azusa are baffled about Ruki allowing Ayato to take Yui. As they try to question Ruki on his intentions, a pack of wolves invade their mansion.

11.o: Yui returns to Mukami's mansion along with Azusa. There, she finds a badly injured Ruki lying on the bed. He's been injured to save Azusa. Kou, Yuma, and Azusa explain to Yui the reason Ruki has been acting strange lately.

12.o: After the Mukami brothers were attacked by wolves, the Sakamaki brothers are attacked as well. They fight off the wolves. The Sakamaki brothers reach a conclusion that the Founders are behind the attacks and they're after Yui Komori.

1.o: رغم معاناته من الإصابة بجروح بليغة، يتوجّه "تانجيرو" إلى منزل عائلة "رنغوكو" ليُطلعهم على آخر الأخبار المأساوية.

2.o: يتنكّر "تانجيرو" والآخرون تحت قيادة "هاشيرا أوزوي تنغن" لإخفاء أنفسهم في مهمة للبحث عن وظيفة في منطقة "يوشيوارا".

3.o: يقرّر "إينوسكي" التسلل إلى غرفة "ماكيو"، وفي غضون ذلك، يسمع "زينيتسو" صوت فتاة صغيرة تبكي ويهرع لمساعدتها، فيما يشعر بوجود طيف غريب خلفه.

4.o: بعد التقائه بسيدة قوية من الشياطين تدعى "داكي"، يختفي "زينيتسو". ويطلب "أوزوي" من "تانجيرو" و"إينوسكي" مغادرة "يوشيوارا".

5.t: Things Are Gonna Get Real Flashy!!
5.o: في الوقت الذي يبحث فيه "أوزوي" عن "هيناتسورو"، يواصل "تانجيرو" النضال في معركته ضد "داكي". إذ يخطّط أن يجرّب أسلوبًا آخر من الهجوم.

6.o: يستخدم "تانجيرو" نفَس "هينوكامي كاغورا" لرد الضربة، لكن "داكي" تستعيد قوّتها حين يهرب وشاح "أوبي" الخاص بها من عش الشيطان ويعود إليها.

7.o: يستميت "تانجيرو" لمنع "نيزوكو" وهي في هيئتها الشيطانية من مهاجمة امرأة مصابة، وذلك حين تعود "داكي" للظهور في حالة أشد غضبًا حتى من السابق.

8.o: يهرع "تانجيرو" و"إينوسكي"، ومعهما "زينيتسو" النائم، لمساندة "أوزوي" الذي بدأت قواه تخور تدريجيًا بسبب السمّ الفتاك الذي تعرض له.

9.o: يختفي "غيوتارو" عن أنظار "أوزوي" ويبدأ في مطاردة "هيناتسورو". وبينما يهرع "تانجيرو" و"أوزوي" لإنقاذها، يعترض حزام "داكي" طريقهما.

10.o: يستيقظ "تانجيرو" ليجد نفسه مُحاطًا بالأنقاض المحروقة، فيما يضحك "غيوتارو" بسخرية على مأساته.

11.o: معركة حامية ضد شيطانيّ الرتبة العليا السادسة. الفريق يواجه تحدياً كبيراً في قتالهم ضد غيوتارو وداكي.

1.o: Soon after a rare chickeraffe goes missing from the Glurfsburg Zoo, Sam and Guy meet by chance at a diner, setting off a series of extraordinary events.

2.o: Guy shows up to return Sam's briefcase, only to learn he's got company. Elsewhere, a mother-daughter duo begins a very slow drive through the desert.

3.o: With the Bad Guys in pursuit, Sam and Guy board a train to Meepville and meet Michellee, a cautious bean counter, and her thrill-seeking daughter, E.B.

4.o: Taking a detour to find the chickeraffe some food, Guy and Sam cross paths with an egg-loving fox who's working hard to control his appetite.

5.o: While seeking shelter for the night, the trio gets stuck in a junkyard. The only upside for an inventor like Guy? It's full of raw materials.

6.o: Panic hits the streets of Prinz Pazookle when the locals learn there's a chickeraffe in town. But a colorful carnival is bringing everyone together.

7.o: A singing rodent comes to the rescue in North Shvizelton when Sam and Guy wind up in jail with no real plan to get themselves out.

8.o: To escape the Bad Guys -- and stormy weather -- Sam and friends spend the night in Michellee's cabin, but trouble follows. Snerz hires outside help.

9.o: Guy and Sam need a next-level plan when Snerz's animal-napper chases them up a cliff. As for the Bad Guys, they're definitely down -- but not out.

10.o: The fugitive friends make a stop in Stovepipe Junction, where Sam gets to meet Guy's family -- and reveals a shocking secret.

11.o: Just as Guy's about to try a bite of breakfast, the Bad Guys bust in with the truth about their mission. Under the sea, the plot thickens.

12.o: After a close call on the docks, Guy gets captured and learns he's been duped. Michellee gives her daughter a tour of Meepville.

13.o: The SnerzDay Gala sets the stage for a surprise ending that's full of twists and turns -- and a heartwarming act of true friendship.

1.o: يواجه الجنرال "مارك نايرد" المقلّد بأربعة نجوم، وقائد وكالة "قوة الفضاء" المؤسسة حديثًا، ضغوط إطلاق قمر صناعي رغم تحذيرات شديدة من العلماء.

2.o: حين يُعرقَل قمر الجنرال "نايرد" الصناعي العزيز بشدّة، يتعيّن عليه الاختيار بين حلّ علمي منطقي وعملية إنقاذ يستعين فيها بشمبانزي.

3.t: MARK AND MALLORY GO TO WASHINGTON
3.o: بينما يستعدّ الجنرال "نايرد" والدكتور "مالوري" لحضور جلسة مثيرة للجدل في "كابيتول هيل"، تتعرّف "إرين" إلى النقيب "آلي".

4.o: يتطوّع الجنرال "نايرد" لـ"تجربة المسكن القمري" التي يجريها دكتور "مالوري"، وتحاول "إرين" إقامة حفل، ويحظى فريق "قوة الفضاء" بمظهر جديد أنيق.

5.o: مجهّزين بأسلحة بعيدة تمامًا عن الترهيب، يلعب جنود "قوة الفضاء"، تحت قيادة الجنرال "نايرد"، ألعاب الحرب مع منافسيهم من جنود "القوات الجوية".

6.o: يطير الجنرال "نايرد" فرحًا بعد فوزه بألعاب الحرب، ولكن سرعان ما يصطدم بأرض الواقع حين يعلم باحتمالية وجود جاسوس بين صفوف "قوة الفضاء".

7.o: تعرض رائدة أعمال مفعمة بالحماسة على "قوة الفضاء" استخدام وقودها المبتكر للصواريخ، ويمنح دكتور "تشان" النقيب "آلي" دورة مكثّفة في علم النبات.

8.o: حان وقت الزيارة الزوجية والجنرال "نايرد" على أتمّ استعداد، بينما يتشارك دكتور "تشان" والنقيب "آلي" السيارة معًا ويسابق دكتور "مالوري" الوقت.

9.t: IT'S GOOD TO BE BACK ON THE MOON
9.ar: من الجيّد أن أعود إلى القمر
9.o: يتعامل الجنرال "نايرد" مع طاقم غير مستعدّ بعد رغم تبقّي بضعة أيام على الإطلاق، وتبحث النقيب "آلي" عن الكلمات المناسبة، وتزور "إرين" والدتها.

10.o: يُصارع الجنرال "نايرد" ضميره وهو تحت ضغط الانتقام من "الصين"، بينما يُطلق دكتور "مالوري" تهديدًا يُنذر بالسوء، وتتمرّد "إرين".

1.o: يقدِّم وزير الدفاع الجديد الجنرال "نايرد" للمحاكمة في وزارة الدفاع، وعلى الفريق أن يستجمع قواه للإدلاء بالشهادة نيابة عنه وإنقاذ مسيرة عمله.

2.o: تواجه ميزانية "قوة الفضاء" انخفاضًا حادًّا، ممّا يثير ذعر الجنرال "نايرد" والدكتور "مالوري"، ويحاول د. "تشان" معرفة سبب ابتعاد النقيب "آلي".

3.o: يبذل الفريق قصارى جهده لتجنّب الإساءة إلى وفد زائر من "الصين"، لكنّ الدكتور "مالوري" يحاول جاهدًا إخفاء مشاعره بشأن مُنكِر هبوط القمر.

4.o: يتعيّن على "قوة الفضاء" اتّخاذ قرار صعب: إمّا استغلال الوقت في إعداد عرض "باوربوينت" عن غزو فضائي أو الانغماس في حيّل مازحة... فماذا سيختارون؟

5.o: تحصل "إرين" على نصائح متضاربة حول مقابلة جامعية، بينما يُنشئ "توني" شراكة جديدة بين "قوة الفضاء" ومشروب طاقة يسمّى "ماد باف".

6.o: ينشر "توني" شائعة في المكتب بأنّ الجنرال "نايرد" يبحث عن وظيفة جديدة، فيما يسعى الدكتور "تشان" والدكتور "مالوري" فعليًّا وراء عرض عمل واعد.

7.o: بينما يصبح مستقبل "قوة الفضاء" في مهبّ الريح، تلوح تغييرات كبيرة في الأفق... لكن يجب على الفريق التعامل أوّلًا مع أزمة اختراق القاعدة بأكملها.

1.o: Two lovebirds. One awful accident. Heather offers Dave a helping hand. Too bad she may never see that hand again.

2.o: Upset. Disfigured. Obsessed with her beauty. Heather insists on an arm replacement made of gold. But it comes at a cost.

3.o: Dave goes against Heather’s last wish to get out of debt. But when you break a promise, the fallout can be deadly.

4.o: A mother and daughter stop to see the world’s largest ball of twine. It may sound boring, but it really draws the daughter in.

5.o: Susan turns to the cops to help find Amelia. Turns out, the town is wound up in something much darker than suspected.

6.o: It’s time to get to the center of the conspiracy. Susan digs in deep in an attempt to pull Amelia out of danger.

7.o: Sebastian Klempner was a taxidermy legend. But after accepting a job for a strange animal, his greatest masterpiece may just be his greatest mistake.

8.o: A knock at the door brings an unexpected visitor. And they are very unhappy with Sebastian’s work. So much so, it just might cost him his life.

9.o: Four pledges are ready to find out if they’re Kappa material. But this initiation ritual is about to get way darker than they expected.

10.o: The pledges free a chained victim and attempt to find help in the woods. Can they trust that whoever they find will be on their side?

11.o: This is no frat initiation. The remaining pledges fight to stay alive as the Grey Cloud villagers all begin to close in.

12.o: Miami police respond to an odd call about a stolen goat. Their body cams and video surveillance reveal what happens when they arrive at the scene.

13.o: Backup arrives at the scene to investigate the missing officers. What they find is horrifying. But for Vasquez, it’s also personal.

14.o: The officers interrupt an ancient ritual. Vasquez fights to keep her partners alive but evil’s grasp is a hard one to break.

1.o: Hannah has a past life. A past trauma. And a terrible fear of heights. Now, one late-night call brings her back to where it all began.

2.o: Hannah and Blake start their climb up the turbine. She just has to remember to go one step at a time. And never look down.

3.o: It’s a race to the top as the lights go out. Can Hannah climb to the engine in time? Or will her past catch up with her?

4.o: When Mallory and her brothers go to the town cemetery to bury their pet, they dig up something much darker than dirt.

5.o: Mallory moves down the underground staircase to rescue Aiden’s toy. But what she discovers down there is far more frightening than the dark.

6.o: A group of ghost-debunking friends visit the haunted Stanley Hotel. When Kyle sneaks down to explore the basement tunnels, the results are life-shattering.

7.o: The phone-obsessed friends grab a drink at the hotel bar. But when Logan heads up to her room, she realizes another guest has checked in.

8.o: Now all alone, Simon wanders the hotel halls looking for his friends. But what he finds instead is far from friendly.

9.o: Azalea and her parents arrive at their new home. All seems well, until she discovers a doll in the cemetery next door.

10.o: Azalea is excited about her new friend, Lucy. But when Lucy says she wants to be friends forever...she really means forever.

1.o: تلتقي الرغبي بفنون القتال المختلطة في لعبة كالتشو ستوريكو شديدة العنف، الرياضة التقليدية لمدينة فلورنسا الإيطالية التي يعود تاريخها إلى نحو خمسمئة عام.

2.o: تجمع ألعاب المرتفعات الاسكتلندية بين الاحتفال الثقافي واختبارات القوة البدنية الشاقة، ومنها رمي جذع الشجرة الفريد.

3.o: الغوص الحر دون أسطوانات أكسجين أسلوب حياة لكثيرين في الفلبين، وهو أيضًا رياضة شاقة تختبر حدود الجسد البشري.

4.o: In Austin, Texas, skaters find an inclusive and supportive community in roller derby, a competition that blends high speed and physical combat.

13.o: Tang Jingze's spirit sword engages Sun Rong and destroys his weapon. Wang Ling's father implores them to stop the competition before someone gets hurt.

14.o: The competition comes to an end. The leader of the League of Shadows attacks and Wang Ling finally loses control.

15.o: Wang Ling quickly realizes his mistake: not having stopped the leader of the League of Shadows sooner, so he decides to take the risk once more.

1.t: Wang Ling Wants To Lead A Quiet Life
1.o: After nearly depleting the planet's spiritual energy by going back in time, Wang Ling dreams of only one thing: to be left alone. Unfortunately, fate seems to have other plans for him.

2.t: A Home Visit By The Demon Master
2.o: Sent to Earth to annihilate the human race and conquer the planet, Chienpaud is far from having achieved his goals. His master decides to come and ask him to account.

3.o: Ten years ago, the famous assassin nicknamed "Vagabond Charmer" disappeared without a trace. Some rumors claim that he is hiding near the 60th school of Songhai…

4.t: How To Forge A Spiritual Sword
4.o: After taking a class on spirit swords at school, Wang Ling and his friends decide to go and have their respective weapons serviced.

5.t: The Four Bizarre Tales of Faction 60
5.o: Four great legends circulate in the 60th school. Is there any truth behind the rumors?

6.t: The Internet Is Not A Lawless Paradise
6.o: Seduced by a streamer, Chen Chao becomes a little too obsessive. His worried friends try to get him back in touch with reality.

7.t: The Foolish Old Man's Spirit in the Sun Family
7.o: The wealthy Sun family is going through a difficult phase. Fortunately, they are not the type to give up.

8.t: A Sword Dance of the Five Elements
8.o: Several students from the 60th school decide to enter the Songhai Artistic Fencing Competition to prove that spiritual swords are more than weapons.

9.t: A Train to the Twinkling Stars
9.o: After the contest misadventure, the whole planet fell madly in love with Sun Rong. If he doesn't quickly find a way to ward off the spell, things will end badly.

10.t: Extra: The Director Is Not Home Today
10.o: The Elite class of the 60th school of Songhai visits an animation studio and discovers the harsh reality of jobs in the sector.

11.o: The Demon Emperor seems to have realized that Wang Ling poses a considerable threat, while Richman is still determined to destroy Earth. The apocalypse is closer than ever.

12.t: The Observer Beyond Time and Space
12.o: The survival of all mankind is threatened by the invasion of demons. Will Wang Ling stand up to an empire that has already conquered countless planets?

1.o: After repelling the demonic invasion, Wang Ling hopes to finally be able to lead a peaceful life. Unfortunately for him, the arrival of a new student will upset his daily life.

2.o: After the destruction of the demon world, the demons were displaced in the human world. The Jiugong family sent their eldest daughter, Jiugong Ryoko, to study at the "Sixty Gates" of the Huaxiu Kingdom to secretly collect demons and send them back to Sun Island. Wang Ling and other people in and Jiugong Ryoko get along, gradually found her and the whole Jiugong family's true purpose ...... against the sky of the immortal king, and this time to secretly why the battle?

3.o: Wang Ling and his friends set out to pick premium immortal herbs. They will quickly realize that they are not alone in the mountains.

4.o: Guo Hao's new familiar leaves no one indifferent. Stella is perpetually surrounded by a crowd of admirers, among which have crept individuals thirsty for unicorn blood.

5.o: A mysterious swordswoman is stirring up trouble in Songhai by systematically challenging every sword-wielder she finds. At the same time, Jingke enters a rebellious phase and refuses to obey Wang Ling.

6.o: The main clans of Songhai are gathered for the sale of the year, where they will have to fight to acquire priceless treasures. Meanwhile, Wang Ling is faced with concerns of an entirely different order.

7.t: Welcome To Join the Exorcist Team!
7.o: The Exorcists seem to have invaded Songhai City. Guo Hao takes a dim view of their presence, unlike Chen Chao who is not insensitive to the charisma of these newcomers.

8.o: For ten years, Zhuo Yi has been the undisputed hero of Songhai City. Unfortunately for him, his imposture is about to come to light.

9.o: Wang Ling and his friends prepare to attend the Saints' Gala, an annual party held at the Sun family's Celestial Paradise. Wang Ling is going to have to prove himself if he is to be considered worthy of staying by Sun Rong's side.

10.t: The Sun Family's Sacred Cudgel Is Lost (Mission Accomplished Version)
10.o: In order to rise in her father's esteem, Yoshiko Kyûmiya is determined to steal the Sun Family's sacred staff. To achieve this, she will have to find a partner and infiltrate the Saints' Day gala.

11.o: With the help of Lord Thunder, Wang Ling and Sun Rong investigate the theft of the sacred staff. They are about to uncover the dark plot that threatens Eternia.

12.o: After many years spent in the human world, Chienpaud's identity is murky. Now that Zhuo Yi has unraveled the secret of the Kyumiya Volcano, the time has come for the former demonic king to choose sides.

1.o: Wang Ling and his comrades first hear of the legendary swordsman Fanrui, who can master the Celestial Style. Under the guidance of Mr. Wang, the students of the 60th school will learn new ways of wielding the sword.

2.o: Sun Rong fainted after falling victim to Wang Ling's flash of amnesia. Her grandfather is worried about her and sends her for a battery of medical exams.

3.o: Fanrui, the immortal swordsman, decided that Wang Ling would make an ideal successor. Unfortunately for him, Wang Ling has no intention of showing him his abilities.

4.o: The earth's crust is dotted with veins that supply the atmosphere with spiritual energy. What would happen if one of these veins was seriously damaged? Wang Ling and his friends are about to have the answer...

5.t: Wang Ling's Art of Great Luck
5.o: Wang Ling decides to make a gift for Zhuo Yi. He goes shopping with his friends, who turn out to be easy prey for unscrupulous sellers. Will Wang Ling manage to save them from debt?

6.o: Wang Ling agreed to participate in the 60th school charity sale. To obtain items to sell, he will once again turn to the Ways.

7.o: After the failures of White Tiger and Azure Dragon, the 60th school will have to deal with the third of the Four Animals. Will the explosive Vermilion Bird be more skilled than his brothers in arms?

8.o: Black Turtle, the last member of the Four Animals, is determined to avenge his brothers. He is preparing to use an ancestral technique to attack the 60th school, whose students are preparing for the worst.

9.o: The Four Animals were actually more than four! The fifth member of this dangerous school decides to attack Sun Rong to avenge his classmates.

10.o: After borrowing a fraction of Wang Ling's strength, Sun Rong is now able to face Ocher Dragon. Will she manage to leave the spiritual dimension of which she is prisoner?

11.o: Taking advantage of a moment of inattention from the guardians, Chen Nanxuan finally managed to awaken to a Way. When he discovers that his disciples have been decimated in his absence, he decides to do everything possible to take revenge.

12.o: Yi Jianchuan finally faces Chen Nanxuan, more powerful than ever after awakening to a Way. Wang Ling's friends are convinced that they are attending an immersive theatrical performance, far from suspecting that the stakes of the fight are very real.

1.o: Wang Ling, his family, and the world are preparing for the arrival of the Immortal King's little sister.

2.o: Wang Ling and his friends are sent to the Songhai First Prison on a field mission.

3.t: What to Do if Being Stuck in Writing
3.o: Wang Ling's father has to write to support his family, but he lacks inspiration.

4.t: The Legendary Cultivator Mystic Ax Spirit Mother
4.o: Wang Ling and his companions are about to learn the Mystic Ax Divine Technique, when Yekui attacks them.

5.o: Wang Zukang's investigations into his teacher's whereabouts lead him to Wang Ling's house.

6.o: The quadrennial Huaxiu Celestial Tournament of Huaxiu is about to begin, and as always, Wang Ling is involved.

7.o: While the monk Jindeng and Master Crispy Noodles face off, Wang Ling's little sister is about to be born.

8.o: Chen Chao and Wang Ling attend a bodybuilding school.

9.t: Making a Sword Spirit for Little Sister
9.o: Wang Nuan's parents want to give her a Spirit Sword while she's still young, but Wang Ling decides to help.

10.o: Wang Nuan doesn't want to be separated from her brother, so Wang Ling is forced to take her to school.

11.o: Wang Ling’s family life is turned upside down with the arrival of a little sister, Wang Nuan.

1.o: How a lizard can literally walk on water; how hippos speed through water if they can’t actually swim; how bees find nectar; jellyfish; cats’ whiskers.

2.o: How do owls sense prey they can't see, why are wild dogs the most efficient hunters, can an octopus disappear, and why don't penguins get cold feet ?

3.t: Backwards Birds and Slimy Sea Creatures
3.o: Looking at the science behind hummingbirds flying backwards, how do dogs know when you are sad, and why Hagfish are just so slimy.

4.t: Puppy Dog Tails and Crocodile Jaws
4.o: Tail wagging actually has a message for you, if you know how to interpret it, and crocodile jaws are powerful in bite mode, but you can hold them closed by hand if you're brave enough.

5.o: Cats can detect earthquakes jut before they happen, and owls can hunt in almost total darkness. Cheetas can accelerate faster than a Supercar, while Otter fur keeps them warm in cold water.

6.o: An elephants truck is an amazingly versatile tool. Ladybugs have spots to warn others that they taste bad. Cats purr not just when they are happy, but sometimes they do it for comfort. Blue Whales are top of the biggest animal chart.

7.o: Dolphins are really intelligent and accomplished hunters. Some cats love swimming in water and some just can't stand it. Hyenas can eat every last piece of a carcass, and geckos have special adaptations which allow them to climb anywhere.

8.t: Space Bugs and Squirrel Mind Maps
8.o: How squirrels hide their food and then find it again. Spitting Cobras, best to just stay far away. An alligator thinks a Tuba is a competitor. The Tardigrade bug can survive in space for some time, could it actually be an Alien ?.

9.o: Believe it or not, mice don't really like cheese, because it can make them sick. When thousands of bats fly they use vision and echo location to avoid colliding. Manatees pass a lot of gas because they eat underwater grasses. Cats jump to catch food.

10.o: Dogs tilt their heads to see better. because their big noses block their vision. Humpback whales jump using their peduncle muscle. Spiders shed their old skin to grow bigger. Hippos sweat sunscreen and some animals swarm as a protection from other predators.

11.o: Dogs and wolves are smarter in different ways. Special fur and black skin keeps a polar bear warm. Some spiders use their silk strands to catch wind for a flight. Dirty fish use other creatures such as cleaner shrimps and wrasse to get cleaned up.

12.o: You will never catch a fly, because its multiple eyes allow it to react way faster. Woodpeckers avoid headaches due to special skull bone. Giraffes' tongues are black to avoid sunburn. Fire ants become their own raft in a flood and can hold their breath too.

13.o: An anteaters sticky tongue allows it to slurp up hundreds of ants. Dogs keep cool by panting over their tongue. Humpback whales sing to communicate over distance. Beavers build dams to attract a mate and protect the family. Dung beetles collect balls so they can have a private meal.

14.o: A dogs nose is so sensitive it can detect smells coming from underwater. Fire flies use chemistry to make light. The long legs of an ostrich makes it nature's fastest runner. Sloths use slow twitch muscles to hang out all day. A pelican bill is really a fish scoop net.

15.t: A Lions Roar and Leafcutter Ants
15.o: Dogs love to roll in poo because it passes messages. Leaf cutter ants cut and carry leaves back to their nest where it feeds fungus which is the ants food. Lions roar to communicate status, availability and territory, and Crabs dress up as camouflage and protection..

16.o: Domestic cats find hard to get down from trees, because their claws are only designed to climb. Kiwis eggs are so big to help the chick to develop. Giraffes can make sounds but only at night. Herring flatulence almost caused a military attack and is used to track each other.

17.o: Caterpillars transform into butterflies only after stuffing themselves with food. Sharks do sleep but in very small amounts. Cat tongues are rough, because they basically comb their fur clean with it. Bats hang upside down because it makes it easier to fly, and Wombats poop cubes because of their intestine design.

18.o: Some cats are cross eyed because of a gene mutation. Meerkats eat poisonous scorpions by snapping off the poisonous tails with their speed. Hippos are able to sleep for hours underwater thanks to a special breathing reflex, and snakes "walk" on their ribs.

19.o: Eagle eyes are so powerful because the actually have built in zoom. Rhino skin is thick for thorn protection in the bush. How does a squirrel take on a dangerous rattle snake ? The planet is overrun with bugs because they are so adaptable, and are able to multiply at speed.

20.o: Some parrots can talk but do they really know what they're talking about? Most bears are coloured to blend in to their surroundings, so why are panda's black and white? What is the longest animal on earth ? Can Electric eels electrocute themselves ?

21.o: Believe it or not Koalas keep cool by hugging trees. Elephants can communicate over vast distances using Infrasound. A frog tongue is both spring loaded and sticky, so bugs beware. Vultures are immune to bacteria due to their stomach acid, and a trapdoor spider can live for 43 years.

22.o: Is a cats meow really trying to communicate to humans? Some of the world's cleverest monkeys have turned to a life of crime because they have learned that people will trade food for their stolen items. Birds don't actually pee because it is mixed with poo.

23.t: Sheep Wrangling Dogs and Turtle Tears
23.o: Sheep dogs, once trained can wrangle an entire herd of sheep, because of their pack hunt instinct. Moths are not really attracted to flames they are heading for the light they put out. Why do turtles cry? Sea otters use stones like we use tools, to get into their food.

24.o: Kangaroos are baby making machines because of simple survival in the wild. Do you know that spiders have up to seven different silk glands, but why don't they get stuck in their own webs? Parrot brains are walnut sized, so why are they so clever ?. How do foxes find water in the desert?

25.o: How do hamsters stuff so much into their cheeks? Despite popular opinion, camels humps do not store water, but are actually fat that is used to survive lean times. How do crocodiles find prey in dirty water ? Plus, why are pigeon wings so noisy ?

26.o: Dogs are being trained to help humans, so how does your dog know when you're sick ? Why do octopuses have blue blood ? Which animals make the most amazing nest? These questions amongst others are investigated by experts to determine how and why.

27.t: Time Telling Dogs and Kangaroo Hops
27.o: Can dogs really tell time or is there some other factor undetectable to us that is helping them ? Why do bees die after they sting you ? What is the secret behind the kangaroo's hop? Plus, why do vultures fly in circles? Experts answer these questions.

28.o: Do subterranean tunnel living mole rats know the secret to a long healthy life or do they have an adaptation that helps them ? How do cats survive falls from height and always land on their feet? How do hummingbirds fly when it is raining? Butterfly wings not only get them around, but markings act to confuse predators.

29.o: Why do rattlesnakes release their prey after biting ? Rhinos have a dangerous reputation, but are they really just insecure softies ? Cows always seem to be chewing so do they like their food that much ? Sperm whales, the biggest animal on earth makes the biggest noise.

30.o: What makes seahorses almost indestructible? Believe it or not dogs bury bones, because their ancestors buried food remains to preserve it. Sealions whiskers can help them catch food in the dark. Elephants can actually detect explosives. Why do birds sing in the morning?

31.o: Dogs barks and howls are a means of communication. Sloths use algae to turn their fur green for camouflage from predators. How do sea turtles navigate their way home? Who is natures greatest jumper, and how do diving beetles spend so long underwater?

32.o: Can animals paws or claws be left or right handed like humans ? Climbing goats risk their lives on cliffs to get salt. Mosquitos are attracted more by smell than other factors. Can snakes hear ? How does a flock of birds act like a swarm of bees ?

33.o: The amazing road from egg to chicken. Dogs love to lick, and there are many reasons why that is. Hearing in the wild is a survival issue, so how do elephants hear something 160Km away ? Amazing animals that can regrow lost limbs and tails, and how does a flying snake fly ?

34.o: The myth is that eating shrimp makes flamingos pink, but the truth is really amazing. Drinking water for humans is easy, for some creatures not so much. How and why do flying fish fly ? The Kimodo dragon can take down a buffalo, and why are some spiders so brightly coloured ?

35.t: Puppy Dog Eyes and Weird Platypus
35.o: Dogs know just how to get their human owners to do what they want. Frog feet, duck bill, lays eggs, stings like a bee and sleeps 14 hours a day, the Platypus is one of the earths strangest mammals. Could the Puffadder be the only snake without a scent and what makes a chimp laugh ?.

36.o: Pigeons breed so fast that a single pair can produce 100 offspring in a single year. An Archer fish is so smart it shoots its prey off the foliage. Turtles always return to their birthplace to lay eggs. How do Trap Jaw Ants bite so fast, and why do Rhino only poop in one spot ?

37.o: Does your dog really feel guilt, or is the act to avoid punishment ? Arctic Terns are absolute masters at using the sun to navigate over thousands of kilometres. The Lace Wing and the Port Jackson Shark have some of the worlds weirdest eggs.

38.o: Do dogs really watch TV or are they reacting to the sound and movement ? Investigatons are carried out on how many different animals are able to seemingly defy gravity. Cuttlefish have become masters of disguise in order to survive. Why do some birds dance ?

39.o: Dogs fur soaks up a lot of water and would take up to a day to dry, but with their special technique, they can remove most of the water in just four seconds. Why spiders dance is investigated. How do birds fly so high without oxygen starvation ?.

40.o: Investigations take place as to how fish walk on land, breath out of water, and survive without open water for up to four years. Would you believe that science has proven that living with a dog in your life just might extend it by some years ?

1.t: The Birds Don't Sing, They Screech in Pain
1.ar: العصافير لا تغني، إنها تصرخ من الألم
1.o: يشعل شجار مع سائقة عدائية غضب "داني" وتنتج عنه مطاردة متأججة عبر المدينة، ويترك ضيف "أيمي" غير المتوقع انطباعًا يستحيل نسيانه.

2.ar: نشوة أن نكون على قيد الحياة
2.o: تعثر "أيمي" الحانقة على هدف جديد لنفسها بينما يبدأ زواجها الذي يبدو مثاليًّا في التدهور، ويسعى "داني" نحو بداية جديدة لمشروع عائلته المتداعي.

3.t: I Am Inhabited by a Cry
3.o: ينفّس "داني" عن انفعالاته في وجود حبيبة قديمة، وتتدهور علاقة "أيمي" و"جورج" مجددًا. وتتخطى عملية احتيال إلكتروني الحدود.

4.t: Just Not All at the Same Time
4.ar: ليس كل شيء في الوقت نفسه
4.o: في الوقت الذي يصبح فيه مستقبل "أيمي" على المحك، تتجه إلى "لاس فيغاس" من أجل العمل، في حين يتابع "بول" المتيّم و"داني" الغاضب مساعيهما الجامحة.

5.o: بينما يكسب "جورج" صديقًا جديدًا، يضع "داني" خطة خطرة، وتوافق "أيمي" على مقابلة، وتتصرّف "نايومي" بناءً على حدسها.

6.o: بسبب تعليقات "فومي" الانتقادية وتدخّل "نايومي" تصل "أيمي" و"جورج" إلى حافة الانهيار. وفيما يهرع "آيزاك" للابتعاد عن المتاعب، يتلقى "داني" عرضًا غير متوقع.

7.o: تحدث تغيّرات إيجابية في حياة "أيمي" و"داني"، ولكن الأسرار العالقة والتحديات العاطفية تجبرهما على مواجهة الحقائق القاسية.

8.o: تدفع ذكريات الشباب الأليمة "أيمي" إلى مواجهة مشاكلها الأسرية وتعاستها الزوجية. ويحوك "داني" كذبة مفصّلة تنتهي به عند منعطف خطير.

9.o: مع ظهور أزمة جديدة، تتجاوز مشاعر "داني" الخوف لتصل إلى الهلع. وتضع "أيمي" مخططًا خطيرًا وهي تعتزم القيام بأي شيء من أجل سلامة "جون".

10.o: تؤدي عواقب أفعال "داني" و"أيمي" بهما إلى موقف سريالي يختبر مدى إدراكهما لواقعهما.

1.t: All the Things We're Never Going to Have
1.ar: كل الأشياء التي لن نحظى بها أبدًا
1.o: يشهد الموظفان "أوستن" و"آشلي"، اللذان يعملان في نادٍ ريفي، شجارًا محتدمًا بين رئيسهما وزوجته، ويقرران استغلال الحدث لتحقيق مصالحهما.

2.t: A New Starting Point for Further Desires
2.o: بينما يحاول "جوش" التهوين من ترقّي "آشلي" في النادي، تسعى "ليندسي" إلى انتقام رخيص. وفي الأثناء، تقترح الرئيسة إجراء تغييرات على الصالة الرياضية.

3.t: The Increasing Flimsiness of Any Certainties About the Future
3.ar: الهشاشة المتزايدة لأي يقين بشأن المستقبل
3.o: يفكر "جوش" و"ليندسي" في بدء فصل جديد من حياتهما، بينما تحثّ "آشلي" خطيبها "أوستن" على التقرب من "يونيس".

4.t: Oh, the Comfort, the Inexpressible Comfort
4.o: حين يعلق "أوستن" و"آشلي" لساعات في غرفة الطوارئ، يتحيّن "جوش" الفرصة لقلب الطاولة عليهما.

5.t: I Am Killing My Flesh Without It
5.o: يبلغ الخلاف الزوجي بين "ليندسي" و"جوش" ذروته حين تقع أزمة مفاجئة في منزلهما.

6.o: يحاول "جوش" و"أوستن" تصفية الأجواء بينهما من خلال جلسة تدريبية، فيما تعمد "ليندسي" لتعليم "آشلي" أصول الفن الرفيع لكسب ودّ الزوجات اللاتي يرتدن النادي.

7.o: على ارتفاع ثلاثين ألف قدم، يتعكّر صفو عطلة الفتيات "آشلي" و"ليندسي" و"آفا"، التي خططن لقضائها في "سول"، بسبب توترات قديمة واكتشافات جديدة واعترافات صادمة.

8.ar: ستبقى الأمور على هذه الحال وعليك أن تطيع
8.o: في خضم صراع من أجل البقاء تدور أحداثه في موطن الرئيسة، يتعيّن على الزوجين اختيار ما سيُضحون به، ولمن ستكون تلك التضحية.

1.o: في لندن، تقرر المغتربة السعودية "رزان" الارتباط برجل بريطاني من أصول باكستانية، لكن الزواج لن يتم قبل حصولها على موافقة عائلتها في جدة.

2.o: تقنع "رزان" والدها بالتعرّف على خطيبها، في حين تذهب "لمار" لقضاء بعض الوقت مع والدها، فتلاحظ تأثير بُعد المسافات على علاقتهما.

3.o: تفكر "رزان" و"سمير" في طريقة أخرى بعد معارضة عائلتيهما لزواجهما، فيما تشعر "لمار" بالغربة في حفل ميلاد ابنة عمتها.

4.o: تُخبر "رزان" عائلتها بتغيير رأيها أثناء تحضيرهم لاحتفالات العيد، في حين تساعد "لمار" خالها في صراع حرج للحصول على الحضانة.

1.o: مع تصاعد توترات الحرب الباردة، تدخل الولايات المتحدة سرًّا المعركة ضد فيتنام الشمالية، بينما تثير الاحتجاجات الواسعة النطاق اضطرابات شديدة في جنوب فيتنام.

2.o: يستذكر الجنود الفيتناميون جذور مسببات صراعهم الوحشي عند خط العرض الـ17، حيث تُلهم حركة الحقوق المدنية الأمريكية موجة جديدة من النشطاء.

3.o: تُبدّد الهجمة العسكرية المفاجئة "تيت" خرافة النصر الأمريكي الوشيك، فيما يتذكر شهود عيان وناجون فظاعات مذبحة "ماي لاي".

4.o: تتزامن حملة القصف السرية الشرسة التي يقودها "نيكسون" و"كيسنجر" مع رفض متزايد للحرب من قدامى المحاربين، بينما تؤجج حادثة جامعة "كينت" غضب الملايين وتثير سخطهم.

5.o: "وفي النهاية، كانت الخسائر البشرية هائلة". تمتد تبعات الحرب إلى ما هو أبعد من سقوط "سايغون"، ويعيد التاريخ نفسه في العراق وأفغانستان.

1.o: As Nie Xiguang nears graduation, her secret crush, Zhuang Xu, invites her to a group dinner celebrating his new job.

2.o: Xiguang prepares for a job interview at a prestigious firm. Former surgeon Lin Yusen proposes a bold strategy at the company's board meeting.

3.o: Xiguang quietly refuses Xu's help on her thesis. Meanwhile, her cousin Jiang Rui tries to recruit her to chaperone a college tour in Europe.

6.o: After a tense meeting with Yusen, Xiguang looks for a chance to prove herself - and shake his icy first impression of her.

7.o: Feeling guilty about wishing Yusen harm, Xiguang volunteers to deliver documents to his home while he recovers from an accident.

8.o: Yusen rushes to help Xiguang after she suffers a serious fall - revealing a gentler side of his personality she's never seen.

9.o: As Xiguang recovers in the hospital, Yusen starts to see her as a friend. Back at work, he suggests a team lunch to lift spirits.

10.o: While attending a wedding as Yusen's plus-one, Xiguang meets his former medical colleagues and learns more about his past career as a surgeon.

11.o: Yusen and Xiguang escape the busy wedding festivities to visit an arcade, where they bond over drinks and a lighthearted competition.

12.o: At the wedding reception, Xu confronts Xiguang about her new friendship with Yusen — forcing her to reckon with her feelings for both men.

13.o: After visiting her grandparents, Xiguang decides to keep her distance from Yusen at work while she makes sense of their unorthodox friendship.

14.o: Xiguang decides to accompany Yusen on a business trip — but before they leave, she sets a ground rule that could shake up their relationship dynamic.

15.o: After their business trip to Guangzhou ends, Yusen and Xiguang explore the city together as she eases her nerves before the flight home.

16.o: Xu organizes a skiing holiday with his family. While setting up for a company annual party, Xiguang defends a coworker from a rude patron's insults.

17.o: Xiguang unexpectedly runs into Xu at a shop during a family trip to Changbai Mountain. Meanwhile, Yusen visits his mother in Beijing.

18.o: Yusen surprises Xiguang at her family's chalet and pretends to be a ski instructor, allowing him to spend more time with her.

19.o: Xiguang sneaks out to surprise Yusen with an intimate excursion, while Jiang Rui grows jealous and challenges him to a snowboarding race.

20.o: After Xu's colleague Kevin suffers a serious injury in a collision on the slopes, Yusen draws on his medical expertise to assist the first responders.

21.o: As an apology for their miscommunication, Yusen invites Xiguang to a personal fireworks display. Meanwhile, Xu extends his trip to look after Kevin.

22.o: Suspicious of Yusen's professional motives, Xiguang's powerful father Nie Chengyuan launches a private investigation into his affairs.

23.o: Chengyuan discovers a shocking truth about Yusen's car accident and confronts his former lover Qian Fangping and her daughter for answers.

24.o: After finalizing the design for her photovoltaic garden project, Xiguang opens a heartfelt letter from Yusen, which sheds light on their first meeting.

25.o: Xu probes Kevin's memories from before his accident. Xiguang tells her mother about her new relationship, inspiring Yusen to share the news as well.

26.o: Before departing on an important work trip, Yusen invites a few close colleagues out to dinner - publicly revealing that his bachelor days are over.

27.o: Yusen opens up to Xiguang about his past and admits that he hopes to leave Shuangyuan Photovoltaic and return to the medical field despite his injury.

28.o: At the kick-off of a new Shuangyuan project, Xiguang displays her newfound confidence while showing her mother Jiang Yun around the company.

29.o: Jiang Yun seeks to buy a major share of Shuangyuan, helping to secure Xiguang's future. Later, she expresses her feelings after the divorce.

30.o: After learning the truth from Chris, Xu rushes to a friend's birthday party, determined to finally confess his true feelings for Xiguang.

31.o: While pitching a new major project, Yusen and Xiguang visit a sought-after building site - only to cross paths with a rival company's arrogant leader.

32.o: When Xiguang hears her grandfather is having dizzy spells, Yusen eagerly volunteers to go with her to the village and diagnose the issue.

33.o: After Chengyuan collapses, paramedics rush him to the hospital, and Xiguang learns he requires a complicated surgery to treat the issue.

34.o: As he prepares for surgery, Chengyuan tries to mend his relationship with Xiguang. Ms. Shen turns to Shuangyuan for support on a key project bid.

35.o: As Fangping's empire crumbles around her, Xiguang and her family gather to celebrate Shuangyuan's success — and toast to the company's new direction.

36.o: Years later, as they flourish in their respective careers, Xiguang and Yusen look to the future and plan the next chapter of their shared life.

6.o: قبل إطلاق مشروع جديد، تدرس شيف عرضًا من ماتسون، بينما يحاول كيندال ورومان تغيير موازين علاقتهما معه

7.o: تتصاعد الخلافات داخل الشركة، بينما يحاول أفراد العائلة التعامل مع مصالحهم المتعارضة قبل صفقة البيع

8.o: خلال ليلة انتخابية حاسمة، تواجه العائلة والشركة قرارات قد تؤثر في مستقبل السلطة والنفوذ

9.o: تجتمع العائلة لتوديع لوغان، بينما تستمر المناورات حول مستقبل الشركة وصفقة بيعها
